comparison.objective: Perform one passive elbow range-of-motion repetition on a manikin; candidate finishes four installed threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Elbow task tests compliant limb support, controlled articulation to a right angle, and return to extension; candidate tests precision rigid tooling, impact regulation, and tiny-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Elbow must bend to 90 degrees, return straight onto the bed, and be released; candidate requires four safe tang fractures, intact retained parts, and all fragments physically contained.
comparison.reason: Compliant human-limb articulation is unrelated to controlled insert-tang fracture and recovery.
